Blueberries: Whole blueberries, frozen loose. Sweet with a gentle tartness behind it, and they hold their shape as they thaw.
Broccoli 1kg: Broccoli florets, frozen, 1kg. Mild and grassy with a faint cabbage note, tender-crisp rather than soft.
California Mixed Vegetables 1kg: A frozen mix of broccoli, cauliflower and carrot, 1kg. Mild and lightly sweet, with three different textures in the bag.
Cauliflower: Cauliflower florets, frozen. Very mild and faintly nutty, and softer than broccoli.
Champignon Slices: Sliced button mushrooms, frozen. Mild and earthy, soft once thawed.
Champignon Whole: Whole button mushrooms, frozen. Mild and earthy, with a firmer bite than the sliced ones.
Edamame 1kg: Young green soybeans in the pod, frozen, 1kg. Firm and nutty with a clean, faintly sweet taste.
Green Asparagus: Green asparagus spears, frozen. Grassy and a little bitter at the stem, sweeter towards the tip.
Green Peas: Garden peas, frozen loose. Small, sweet and tender — the sweetest of the frozen vegetables here.
Mixed Berries: A frozen mix of berries. Tart and sweet at once, darker and sharper than any single berry on its own.
Mixed Vegetables (Frozen Mixed): A frozen mix of diced vegetables. Mild and lightly sweet, with a range of colours and textures in one bag.
Raspberry (Whole): Whole raspberries, frozen. Sharply tart with a perfumed sweetness, and they soften a lot as they thaw.
Red Pepper Dices: Red bell pepper, diced and frozen. Sweet and mild, with no heat in it at all.
Shiitake Slices: Sliced shiitake mushrooms, frozen. Far stronger than button mushrooms — deeply savoury, almost meaty.
Spinach Ball: Chopped spinach frozen into portion-sized balls. Mild and mineral, with the slight chalkiness spinach has.
Strawberry: Whole strawberries, frozen. Sweet with a light tartness, and soft once thawed.
Sweet Corn Kernels: Sweetcorn kernels, frozen loose. Sweet and juicy, with a firm pop to each kernel.
Baked Puff: Puff pastry baked around a savoury filling, in two kinds. Flaky and buttery outside, soft and salty in the middle.
Bambi Spring Roll 200g(Lumpia Wrapper): Lumpia wrappers from Bambi, 200g — thin sheets of plain pastry. Almost tasteless on their own, since they are the wrapper and not the filling.
Burger Buns (Pack of 2): Two soft burger buns. Lightly sweet and springy, with a thin pale crust.
Cake in a Tub: Layered cake sold in a tub, in nine flavours. Soft and moist all the way through, sweeter and creamier than a plain sponge.
Cinnamon Rolls 2-pack: Two soft rolls coiled around cinnamon sugar. Sweet and warm-spiced, stickiest towards the middle.
Coconut Wraps 5pcs (Coco Heaven): Five thin wraps made from coconut, by Coco Heaven, in four kinds. Pliable and faintly sweet, with a clear coconut taste.
Cornish Pasty: A folded pastry filled with beef and root vegetables. Thick short crust around a savoury, peppery filling.
Croissant 2-pack: Two butter croissants. Flaky and layered, lightly sweet and rich from the butter.
Hotdog Buns 2-pack: Two long soft buns, sized to hold a hotdog sausage. Lightly sweet and springy, like the burger buns in a different shape.
Pain au Chocolate 2-pack: Two croissant-dough pastries rolled around dark chocolate. Buttery and flaky, with a bitter-sweet centre.
Sausage Roll: Sausage meat baked inside puff pastry. Flaky outside, savoury and peppery in the middle.
Sourdough Bread 2-pack: Sourdough bread, two to a pack. Chewy with an open crumb and a firm crust, carrying the mild sourness long fermentation brings.
Sticky Toffee Pudding: A dark sponge pudding made with dates, under toffee sauce. Very sweet and moist, with a deep caramel flavour.
Tortilla Wraps (Liberty): Soft flour tortillas from Liberty, in white and wholewheat. Pliable and mild; the wholewheat ones taste nuttier and eat a little heavier.
Expat Meals: Prepared main courses in trays — seven dishes, and two tray sizes for the lasagna. Homely, familiar Western cooking rather than anything fancy.
Pie (Zac's Pie House): Hand-sized pies from Zac's Pie House, in twelve fillings — beef, pork, vegetarian, breakfast and two sweet ones. Short, flaky pastry around a thick filling.
Pizza: Pizza in five kinds, from plain cheese through meat, seafood and vegetarian. Thin base with tomato and melted cheese under whatever the topping is.
Dark Chocolate Pistachio Kunafa: Shredded kunafa pastry with pistachio, coated in dark chocolate. Very sweet and nutty, with a crisp, stringy crunch inside.
Hormel Chili with Beans 425g: Tinned chilli con carne with beans from Hormel, 425g. Thick and mildly spiced — savoury rather than hot.
Olive Oil Mayonnaise 887ml (Kraft): Kraft mayonnaise made with olive oil, 887ml. Thick and creamy with a mild tang, a little fruitier than plain mayonnaise.
